notices.text:
TerraForest combat additions — 2026-11-01

New code: SPDX-License-Identifier: 0BSD.
Original barrel geometry generated by combat_barrel.gd, sound waveforms generated
by combat_world.gd, explosion visual parameters, and art/carbine.svg,
art/cartridge.svg, art/explosive_barrel.svg: CC0-1.0.
To the extent possible under law, the contributors dedicate these new original
assets to the public domain under CC0-1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

Creator/tool: OpenAI Codex, at the maintainer's request on 2026-11-01 to add the
first firearm, projectiles, zombie responses, explosive terrain damage, flying
building blocks and optional structural integrity. Original procedural geometry,
vector paths, noise synthesis and code were authored directly in this repository.
No external asset, animation, audio pack or copied implementation was imported.

Existing carbine mesh and rifle animation clips are reused from
addons/characters/runtime/assets/Human.r11.glb. Their existing authorship, terms
and recorded provenance remain unchanged; this notice does not relicense them.
See addons/characters/LICENSE.txt and docs/LICENSE_INVENTORY.md.
Generated debris uses the existing native building-shape preview mesh.

External development tools: the existing pinned Godot engine and native Zig /
godot-cpp toolchain, with their established terms and distribution notices.

notices.title: Original building expansion materials E2
notices.summary: Eight original image-generated materials contributed under CC0. The source manifest retains prompts, source hashes and technical preparation; existing material sets retain their own terms.
notices.text:
# Building expansion materials E2

These eight new original material assets are contributed under **CC0-1.0** by
TerraForest contributors, to the extent copyright or related rights exist and
are held by the contributors. The dedication follows the project's contribution
terms; it does not purport to license third-party rights.

CC0 legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

Covered files: `aged_brick.trtex`, `weathered_plaster.trtex`,
`coursed_limestone.trtex`, `weathered_timber.trtex`, `slate.trtex`,
`patinated_zinc.trtex`, `aged_terracotta.trtex`, `soot_stone_trim.trtex`.
They are opaque RGB PNG data loaded through the native shared texture array.

Each material was generated separately with the built-in OpenAI image generation
tool for this project on 2026-10-30; timber received a layout correction on
2026-10-31. No downloaded material, external image, branding or third-party
reference was supplied. The existing project's material set was visually
inspected to describe its general dark, weathered character in original prompts.
The timber edit used only this contribution's first generated timber image.
The authoring service is an external tool; its software is not distributed here.

The adjacent `provenance.json` identifies exact source/output hashes, prompts,
dimensions and technical preparation. Full generated masters, the rejected timber
variant, the edit prompt and the 1024 comparison tiles are retained under
`reviews/building_expansion/materials_v2/` in the source checkout, outside game
exports. Godot performs only RGB conversion and Lanczos resizing for runtime use.
The rejected procedural E1 set and its original provenance remain archived.

The dedication is separate from visual acceptance. E2 is a review candidate;
existing approved textures and legacy saved material identities are unchanged.

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

To the extent possible under law, the contributors dedicate the newly authored
project code, test scene, zombie animation trajectories, material modifications,

under the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.

You may copy, modify, distribute and use this original content, including for

but is not required. The content is provided without warranty to the extent

Full CC0 1.0 legal text:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

INHERITED CHARACTER PROVENANCE

The character is based on assets/Human.realistic.glb in the user-supplied
FirstPersonLab.r3(1).zip. That source identifies its content as CC0-1.0 and
states that its base geometry and textures retain the provenance of the
original user-supplied asset. This derivative retains that provenance; this
dedication grants only rights held by the contributors to this delivery.

Source GLB SHA-256:
667f7746d21cd19db6b2c796a2e9b741269312265cbdf7f14a8e3c799f7914e2

No external models, texture packs, animation packs, motion capture, add-ons or
third-party Python libraries were added. Blender's bundled APIs, Godot's built-in
features and Python's standard library were used for authoring and validation.

Godot and Blender are separate software products. Their licenses continue to
apply to those applications; neither application is distributed in this archive.

ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL SLEEPER ANIMATIONS — 2026-11-01

runtime/assets/Zombie.sleepers.res and authoring/Zombie.sleepers.* add six
original seated/lying sleep and wake trajectories, including crawling exits,
authored with OpenAI Codex at the maintainer's request. This new animation and
clearance-envelope data is contributed under CC0-1.0. The retained R4 rig, meshes,
materials and endpoint idle poses keep the inherited provenance stated above;
no third-party motion capture or animation pack was imported. Exact source hash,
tool version and samples are in authoring/Zombie.sleepers.json. The new authoring,
conversion and validation code is separately marked 0BSD, not relicensed by this
asset dedication. See runtime/assets/Zombie.sleepers.LICENSE.txt for exact paths.

notices.title: Original woven woodland clothing
notices.summary: Three original parametric garments, weave materials and clothing icon/drop derivatives. Portable garment exports contain no inherited character body or rig.
notices.text:
# Woven woodland clothing, revision 1

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

To the extent possible under law, TerraForest contributors dedicate the original
garment geometry, fabric patterns, materials, weights and non-code authoring data
in this pack to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal, including its fallback
license and warranty disclaimer. This contribution was authored with OpenAI Codex
at the maintainer's request on 2026-11-01 under the repository's contribution terms.

Full legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

## Exact scope and origin

- `301.res`, `302.res`, `303.res`: original hood, vest and paired footwrap meshes,
  embedded original mathematical weave textures and named-bone weight palettes.
- `301.glb`, `302.glb`, `303.glb`: portable, unrigged exports of those same original
  meshes and embedded materials. These files contain no character body or rig.
- `301__albedo.png`, `301__albedo2.png`, `302__albedo.png`, `302__albedo2.png`,
  `303__albedo.png`, `303__albedo2.png`: Godot's extracted copies of the original
  embedded weave patterns. Associated `.import` files are generated import metadata.
- `manifest.json`: version, prompt, tool version, recipe and output SHA-256 hashes.
- `derivatives.json`: hashes and scopes of the extracted textures, ground models
  and shared icon atlas at the verified bake.
- `../../../player_runtime/art/drops/301.res`, `302.res`, `303.res`: normalized
  dropped-item derivatives generated by `tests/bake_item_icons.gd`.
- Clothing tiles `301`, `302`, `303` in
  `../../../player_runtime/art/item_icons.trtex`: rendered derivatives. The rest
  of that shared atlas retains its own provenance; this notice does not relicense it.

All geometry is independently constructed from mathematical rings, panels,
bindings and boxes in `tools/author_woven_clothes.gd`. Fabric pixels are generated
from a small periodic weave formula. No garment models, textures, reference images,
motion capture or third-party code were imported or traced. The original request
was to author/add wearable 3D clothing for the existing character view.

The existing R11 body was inspected for fit and named-bone compatibility within
its existing runtime use. No R11 vertices, textures, animation tracks or skeleton
are included in these garment exports. The existing character and screenshots
showing it retain the inherited provenance in `addons/characters/LICENSE.txt` and
GAP-002 in the license inventory; this notice does not resolve that record.

Godot 4.7.2 and OpenAI Codex were external authoring tools. They are not distributed
as part of this asset pack. Newly authored generator, adapter and verification
scripts are separately marked 0BSD. Reproduction instructions are in README.md.

notices.title: Original trail clothing
notices.summary: Original broad-brimmed hat, belted jerkin and tall boots, with editable parametric source and matching item derivatives. Character body and rig are not included in portable garment exports.
notices.text:
# Trail clothing pack, revision 1

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

To the extent possible under law, TerraForest contributors dedicate the original
trail garment geometry, materials, fabric pattern, weights and non-code authoring
data in this delivery to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal, including its
fallback license and warranty disclaimer. Authored with OpenAI Codex on 2026-11-01
at the maintainer's request to apply the woven outfit to the trader and try further
3D clothing packs, under the repository's contribution terms.

Full legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

## Exact scope and provenance

- `304.res`, `305.res`, `306.res`: original broad-brimmed hat, belted jerkin and
  tall boots; embedded materials and ten named skin influences.
- `304.glb`, `305.glb`, `306.glb`: unrigged portable garment-only exports. No
  inherited character body, skeleton or animation is included.
- `304__albedo.png`, `305__albedo.png`: Godot-extracted copies of the embedded
  original periodic weave pattern. `.import` sidecars are generated import metadata.
- `manifest.json` and `derivatives.json`: original provenance and output receipts.
- `../../../player_runtime/art/drops/304.res`, `305.res`, `306.res`: normalized
  garment derivatives, baked with the original project's item-bake tool.
- Only tiles 304–306 of `../../../player_runtime/art/item_icons.trtex`: rendered
  garment derivatives. Other tiles retain their existing terms and provenance.

`tools/author_trail_clothes.gd` independently authors the new hat crown/brim/band,
jerkin panels/fastenings/belt/pouch and boot shafts/laces/cuffs. It reuses original
0BSD primitive/weight/material helpers from `tools/author_woven_clothes.gd`.
Both scripts remain 0BSD. No external model, texture pack, reference image or
third-party code was imported. The exact recipes, hashes, user intent and external
Godot version are recorded in the manifest; Godot and Codex are authoring tools,
not components distributed with this pack.

The retained R11 body was inspected for fit within its existing runtime scope.
No R11 mesh, rig or texture is copied into these portable exports. Screenshots
showing that body and the runtime character retain `addons/characters/LICENSE.txt`
and GAP-002 in the license inventory. This asset dedication does not resolve or
widen that inherited provenance claim.

notices.summary: User-supplied door, chest, chair, table and bookshelf masters and runtime derivatives, with explicit contributor CC0 authorization and retained source provenance.
notices.text:
# BG5 runtime assets — CC0-1.0

The supplied door, chest, chair, table and bookshelf masters were contributed by
the TerraForest user, who reports creating all model, texture and reference
inputs using their own/generated material through the ChatGPT website, Pro plan.
On 2026-10-30 the contributor explicitly confirmed:

> All inputs were mine/generated by me; CC0 approved.

The five masters and their derived geometry, textures and runtime exports are
dedicated under [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
To the extent permitted by law, the contributor waives copyright and related
rights in this material under that dedication, including for commercial reuse.

Exact original hashes, supplied filenames and retained source statements are in
`authoring/bg5/provenance.json` in the source repository. That folder retains the
unchanged editable GLBs, parts and animations. Original embedded reconstruction
and reference metadata remain intact. The authoring tool is recorded separately;
its use alone is not the basis for this grant.

Derived scope: `door_model.tres`, `storage_chest_model.tres`, `chair_model.tres`,
`table_model.tres`, `shelf_model.tres`, `../textures/bg5/`, `../door_animation/`, and
`mods/bg5_runtime/`. The conversion recipe and output hashes are in
`authoring/bg5/runtime_recipe.json` and `mods/bg5_runtime/bake.json`.
The compact Open/Close rig retains the master's handle and latch channels;
its source, conversion tool and output hashes are in
`addons/structures/door_animation/provenance.json`.
Existing project code, native libraries and unrelated assets retain their terms.
